campaign_two_pockets_changed_disclosure..prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied approved fictional backpack campaign to create ONE controlled comparison asset for a developer tutorial. Keep the same navy blue backpack, same fabric color, body shape, size, straps, handle, metal hardware style, position, green background, steel bottle, lighting, headline 'READY FOR THE WEEKEND', and subheading 'Your everyday carry'. Make ONLY these two intentional changes: (1) replace the single large rectangular front zippered pocket with TWO clearly separate smaller rectangular navy zippered pockets, stacked vertically on the front panel; make the two pockets unmistakably countable and both fully visible. Keep the rest of the backpack unchanged. (2) Replace the bottom disclosure 'Illustrative product image' with the different exact text 'Actual product photograph'. Render this new disclosure sharply, plainly and fully readable in the same bottom placement and dark sans serif style. No blur. Do not change the navy color or redesign anything else. Maintain the original landscape 1536x1024 framing if possible. No extra text, logos, annotations, highlights or watermarks. This is a deliberately noncompliant campaign variant, not a claim about the image's origin.
